title: LicencePayload v2 (Stage 4 editions)
description: Offline Ed25519-signed licence with editions and a pack subscription separate from the app licence (PRD v4.0 §10). licence_payload.schema.json v1.0.0 stays frozen and valid; v1 licences keep v1 semantics and unlock no Stage 4 surface unless reissued as v2.

expires_at_unix_ms.description: App licence expiry. Past => EXPIRED => vault read-only (v1 rule unchanged).

pack_subscription_until_unix_ms.description: After this, installed packs stay usable at their last currency_date with an 'updates expired' notice; no new deltas. Never blocks reading or exporting existing work.

seat_transfers_per_year.description: Owner decision Q-S4-07; null = not yet decided (transfer disabled).

seat_transfers.description: B-S4-22 (additive, optional): seat transfers this licence has already used, signed by the issuer when it re-issues the licence for a new machine. Counted over a rolling 365 days against seat_transfers_per_year; more in the window than the limit, or any when the limit is null, makes the licence invalid.

institution_key_id.description: Institution-issued certificate signing key (Q-S4-09); null = per-install key only.

x-caseforge.inherits: fingerprint 3-of-4, canonical signing bytes, trust file, EXPIRED=read_only_vault and user_data_may_be_ransomed=false from v1 apply unchanged.
x-caseforge.edition_to_feature_map: contracts/edition_entitlements.json (B-S4-22), DEVELOPMENT_ONLY until the owner decides Q-S4-06. A licence's features[] can only narrow what its edition includes in that map.
amendments: B-S4-22: optional seat_transfers added (additive; every licence valid before stays valid and means the same).
x-caseforge.v1_compatibility: A valid v1 payload stays ACTIVE/EXPIRED under v1 rules and grants none of the Stage 4 feature ids.
